- U7: Add support for "undeployed" status consistently across all deployers (applicable for existing streams without deployment context)
- U8: Add "undeployed" status for k8s SPI

   - U3: Separate repo for K8s SPI

**Undeployed status feature:**
6. Core SPI contract changes: add "undeployed" state to DeploymentState enum / AppStatus (U7 - this is the cross-cutting concern)
7. CF SPI: implement undeployed status (U5)
8. Lattice SPI: implement undeployed status (U6)
9. K8s SPI: implement undeployed status (U8)
10. Handle existing streams without deployment context (U7)
11. Testing and documentation

- Maven/Gradle build for new repos (Spring Cloud Deployer projects typically use Maven)

- Backward compatibility: streams without deployment context map to UNDEPLOYED instead of UNKNOWN
- Git history preservation vs. fresh start for extracted repos (assume fresh extraction with history where feasible)

- Existing codebase is Spring Cloud Data Flow with deployer SPIs (CF, Lattice, K8s, Mesos) bundled under one admin project
- Repos hosted on GitHub; team has admin rights to create repos
- Mesos SPI work already exists locally (U1 says "existing work"), so PR prep only

- A6: Remove extracted SPI code from admin project, update dependencies/build (6h)

Phase 3: Undeployed status (U5-U8)
- A7: Core SPI: add UNDEPLOYED to DeploymentState enum and default handling in spring-cloud-deployer core (U7 foundation) (8h)
- A8: CF SPI: implement undeployed status mapping (U5) (6h)
- A9: Lattice SPI: implement undeployed status mapping (U6) (6h)
- A10: K8s SPI: implement undeployed status mapping (U8) (6h)
- A11: Cross-deployer consistency: handle existing streams without deployment context, default to undeployed instead of unknown (U7) (8h)

Phase 4: Verification & Release
- A12: Unit and integration testing across all affected modules (10h)

- Cross-cutting handling for streams without deployment context: defaulting logic, tests. 8h.

technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is Java 17+ with the existing Spring-based (Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring Cloud Deployer style) build stack, using Maven per-repository builds consistent with the current admin project.

Each SPI variant (Lattice, K8s, Mesos) is extracted from the monolithic admin project into its own standalone repository with its own build descriptor, unit tests, README, and CI pipeline configuration, while preserving package names to minimize downstream breakage.

A new UNDEPLOYED value is added to the shared DeploymentState enumeration in the core deployer SPI module, and each deployer implementation (CF, Lattice, K8s, Mesos) maps its platform-specific 'no deployment / zero instances' condition to UNDEPLOYED instead of UNKNOWN.

Streams that have no deployment context (no deployment properties/manifest recorded) resolve to UNDEPLOYED by default in the shared status-resolution logic, guaranteeing consistent behavior across all deployers without requiring a data migration.
The change is backward compatible: UNKNOWN remains in the enum for genuinely indeterminate states (e.g., platform errors), while UNDEPLOYED covers the definitive 'nothing deployed' case.
The Mesos SPI work already exists locally (per U1), so only branch cleanup, commit squashing, PR creation, and review iterations are required.
CI pipeline definitions are cloned from the existing admin project's pipeline and trimmed to each SPI repository's needs.
assumptions: The codebase is a Spring Cloud Data Flow-style project where CF, Lattice, K8s, and Mesos deployer SPI variants are currently bundled under one admin project.
The developer has permission to create new repositories and configure CI for them.
Git history preservation for extracted modules is not required; a clean initial commit per new repository is acceptable.
Existing unit and integration test suites cover current status handling and only need extension, not rewrite.
No persistent schema change is needed: the undeployed status is derived at runtime for streams lacking deployment context.
One senior-level developer performs all work; estimates assume familiarity with the codebase and with each target platform's status APIs.
No external stakeholder approvals, security reviews, or release-coordination gates are included in the effort.
Review feedback cycles are limited to one normal round per PR.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the bundled SPI variants inside the admin project, map dependencies between modules, identify the status-handling code paths (DeploymentState, AppStatus, per-deployer status() implementations), and define the extraction plan and the undeployed-status design.

Create the new Lattice SPI repo, extract the Lattice deployer module from the admin project, set up Maven build, move and adapt its tests, configure CI, add README/license, and verify a green standalone build.

Create the new K8s SPI repo, extract the Kubernetes deployer module from the admin project, set up Maven build, move and adapt its tests, configure CI, add README/license, and verify a green standalone build.
Create the new Mesos SPI repo, extract/re-home the Mesos deployer module, set up Maven build, move and adapt its tests, configure CI, add README/license, and verify a green standalone build.

activities.activity_name: Prepare and submit PR for existing Mesos SPI work (U1)
activities.activity_description: Clean up the existing local Mesos SPI work (rebase, squash commits, polish code and tests), write the PR description, submit the PR to the new Mesos SPI repo, and address one round of review feedback.

activities.activity_name: Remove extracted SPIs from admin project
activities.activity_description: Remove the Lattice, K8s, and Mesos modules from the admin project, update its build descriptors and dependency management to reference the new standalone artifacts, and verify the admin project still builds and passes tests.

activities.activity_name: Core SPI: add UNDEPLOYED deployment state (U7 foundation)
activities.activity_description: Add the UNDEPLOYED value to the shared DeploymentState enum in the core deployer SPI module, update state-transition/Javadoc documentation, and add unit tests for the new enum behavior.
Update the Cloud Foundry deployer's status mapping so apps with no deployment return UNDEPLOYED instead of UNKNOWN; add/adjust unit and integration tests.
Update the Lattice deployer's status mapping so apps with no deployment return UNDEPLOYED instead of UNKNOWN; add/adjust unit and integration tests.
Update the Kubernetes deployer's status mapping so apps with no deployment return UNDEPLOYED instead of UNKNOWN; add/adjust unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Cross-deployer undeployed handling for streams without deployment context (U7)
activities.activity_description: Implement shared status-resolution logic so existing streams with no associated deployment context consistently report UNDEPLOYED across all deployers; add regression tests covering each deployer.

Run full unit and integration test suites across the core module and all four SPI repositories, execute manual smoke checks of status transitions (deployed, deploying, failed, undeployed, unknown), and fix defects found.
Update READMEs and reference documentation in each new SPI repository, document the new UNDEPLOYED status semantics and migration notes, and draft release notes for the increment.
